files.summary: align the foundation with delivered authoring and finite manufactured-material reuse
edits:
A current saved recipe includes its original candidate, exact family pin and all compiler-read definition/policy pins. Reopening recomputes the native meaning and refuses incompatible bytes instead of substituting a family or converting a save. For the original four weapon/tool families, the compiler derives the supported non-food/non-fuel material-property union from inputs; their current candidate removes the former option to choose a smaller output-property subset. Other installed families own their own supported output properties and material interfaces. The later woven-container and manufactured-cordage families supply one certified invented-input chain, not general recursive composition or live family installation/removal. Generated text cannot invent properties, certificates or effects. [Authored families](worlds/base/invention-families.md) own bundled rules; [PW02](maintainers/parallel-batch-01-playable-week.md#pw02--world-owned-invention-families-and-one-admission-path) owns integration status and [RF01](limits/inventions.md#rf01--world-owned-recipe-families) owns remaining qualification limits.
The [world-agent tool contract](invention-workshop-tools.md) owns one application tool service for the UI and [MCP transport](world-agent-mcp.md). The [unified World Agent runtime](world-agent-runtime.md) owns conversation, native Macrofold execution and session funding. The [relationship graph](invention-graph.md) owns typed navigation/projections, and [composition and revision](invention-composition.md) supplies the end-to-end kind-adapter and live-law workflow beneath the existing module/declaration owners. [Target scenarios](invention-scenarios.md) define the player/NPC outcomes and staged capability sequence. These are accepted designs with finite [source/MCP readers](architecture.md#repertoire-relationship-and-mcp-foundation), exact reviewed writes, local native-harness execution and custom attribute/binding/value adapters already delivered. [WW](maintainers/world-agent-writes.md) retains deployed-build and broader qualification, and INV retains general interaction validation, composition and art. The current service must not be described as only the original read-only bootstrap or as delivering all of this packet.
A simple low-impact invention can auto-activate within its already authorized envelope. Ordinary supported recipe admission already uses that path; the current owner-authoring session requires exact human approval before its first live write, with broader automatic session approval still under INV-18.2. Shared-law changes, destructive migrations, expanded scope/cost, and conjuring keep their explicit review requirements. Do not add human approval to every harmless stage or tool call. Conversely, an art approval never approves mechanics.
Extend the delivered supported-family and native World Agent paths rather than rebuild them. The shared tool service, exact human review/Apply, scoped graph reads and custom attribute/binding/value adapters have recorded local evidence; NP03 separately proves certified manufactured cordage used by a woven-container recipe. Those finite slices do not establish general composition, autonomous investigations, live shared-law revision or target-deployment qualification. The current session allowance and separately billed shared Worker capacity remain under [runtime funding](world-agent-runtime.md#1-product-decisions); image-inclusive attribution is an accepted target, not an enabled paid-image pipeline. Add progressive art through the relevant supported families without blocking already delivered graph/agent work. Use the phase gates in [Target scenarios](invention-scenarios.md#capability-ladder-and-stop-conditions). Cost optimization follows capable, accountable operation; permission, correctness and work bounds are not deferred. General G2, distributed hosting, marketplace automation and exhaustive physics are not first-slice prerequisites.
